shellCommands.command: ls -la /workspace && echo "---GIT---" && git -C /workspace log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null || echo "no commits yet"
ls /workspace/node_modules/.bin/ | grep -i next; echo "---"; npm ls next 2>/dev/null; echo "---node---"; node --version; echo "---npm---"; npm --version
npm ls next react react-dom typescript 2>/dev/null

npm run dev > /tmp/next-dev.log 2>&1 &
echo "dev pid: $!"
sleep 8
echo "--- log ---"
cat /tmp/next-dev.log

echo "=== HOME ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -oE 'Piranesi|Susanna Clarke|Three-Body Problem|Liu Cixin|Currently reading|Finished|Reading List' | sort -u
echo "=== DETAIL (real) ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111 | grep -oE 'Piranesi|Susanna Clarke|Loved the atmosphere|My notes|Copy link' | sort -u
echo "=== DETAIL (missing) status ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:3000/books/does-not-exist

pkill -f "next dev" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; rm -f /workspace/data/books.json; rmdir /workspace/data 2>/dev/null; echo "cleaned up"; ls /workspace/data 2>&1 || echo "data dir removed (will be recreated on first run)"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3000/ 2>&1 || echo "server stopped"; echo; ls -la /workspace/data 2>&1 || echo "data/ absent (recreated on first run)"

rm -f /workspace/data/books.json && rmdir /workspace/data 2>/dev/null; if [ -e /workspace/data ]; then echo "data/ still exists:"; ls -la /workspace/data; else echo "data/ removed — will be recreated empty on first run"; fi

echo "=== Source tree ==="; find /workspace/src -type f | sort; echo; echo "=== Root files ==="; ls -1 /workspace/*.json /workspace/*.mjs /workspace/*.ts /workspace/AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null; echo; echo "=== git status ==="; git -C /workspace status --short
